init.docContent:
Welcome to KenFutWiki

KenFutWiki is a knowledge base and article publishing system for content operations.

You can create documents, publish articles, and configure CTA buttons and related links at the end of an article.

Remove this sample document and start writing your own content.

operations.title: Content operations & product integration
operations.subtitle: KenFutWiki · Public content, multi-product links & conversion analytics
operations.registerHint: After registering pages, operators can select them in the page picker; product credentials are used only on the product server.
operations.originHint: Scheme, host, and port only, without path; localhost HTTP is allowed for local reference products
operations.credentialsHint: The full credential is shown only once after creation. Store it in the product server's environment variables; never put it in the browser or redirect links.
operations.attributionHint: Attribution is calculated per product: the last valid CTA click within 30 days wins, registration locks the source, and first successful generation inherits it. Views and clicks come from the site; the latter two stages are reported by the product server.
operations.registrationsMissing: No registration server events received yet
operations.generationsMissing: No first-generation server events received yet
operations.documentViews: Document views (separate metric, not part of the article funnel)
operations.visitorSummary: Attributed registered visitors: {{registered}} · First-success visitors: {{generations}}. Conversion rates are de-duplicated by source visitor; product account counts are shown separately.
operations.serverEventsHint: Server events are not fully connected yet. Connection status is based on whether the corresponding event has ever been received, regardless of the selected date range.
operations.metricNote: Article views count article pages only; document views are shown separately and excluded from the funnel. View counts, unique visitors, and product accounts are different metrics; unattributed events are never forced into article conversions.
operations.funnelEmptyHint: Select a date range and product to query. A product that has not reported events is not necessarily integrated for conversions.
operations.emptyProductsHint: Register a product and its pages first, then select targets in article CTAs. Registration and generation results are reported by the product server.
operations.contentHint: The "Article settings" at the top of the editor supports drafts. Here you can select published pages to adjust the article entry, cover, categories and tags, recommendations, and CTAs; publish the document after saving.
operations.selectContent: Select content and edit operations attributes
